Korea now has $1.4bn of BTC after swaps. OKX suspends DEX services after Bybit hack. SOL futures set to go live on CME today. SOL DEX volumes hit YTD low, BNB flips SOL. TON jumps 20% as Durov returns to UAE. US is going to be the global crypto hub: Bessent. Crypto now a competition for us: Goldman Sachs. S. Korea central bank rules out BTC reserve. ETH shorts continue to hit record levels. Base paid $300k to ETH last month ‘not $11k’. ETH & ZKSync have 80% RWA market share. Aave DAO votes for no new RWA token.
articles.title: Huge week for Macro, BNB leads L1s, $6.4B of Crypto Outflows

articles.description: Tarun Gupta spoke to Decrypt about Coinshift's yield-bearing stablecoin csUSDL, and how stablecoins will prove the utility of blockchain-powered trustless financial architecture—ultimately bringing 'every other instrument' on-chain.
articles.title: Coinshift CEO: Next-Gen Stablecoins Will Underpin 'Trillions of Dollars in Value'

articles.description: Bitcoin follows strength in gold despite weak stocks. ’No limit’ to size of strategic BTC reserve. CZ denies rumours of Trump stake in Binance US. HYPE bounces as it adds 20% margin requirement. S & SEI lead alts after large TVL increases. WLFI completes token sale for $550m. Vote to reduce SOL’s inflation fails to pass. Russia using crypto to bypass oil sanctions. 3AC increases claim on FTX, jeopardises re-org. Vermont drops staking case against Coinbase. Stablecoin market cap reaches ATH $235.7bn. US seizes $86m crypto linked to Silk Road ops. Coinbase Ventures to lead Base on Echo platform.
articles.title: BTC remains at $83K, CZ denies Binance sale rumour, HYPE bounces back

articles.title: Roman Coppola on the Enduring Relationship Between Film and Technology

articles.title: How DeFi Is Reshaping the Movie Industry

articles.title: Venmo Founder Explains The Plan With JellyJelly

articles.description: Crypto rally post CPI fails to hold. BTC dominance hits 4-year high. ETH/BTC hits 5 year low. ETH drops out of top 20 revenue protocols. Stablecoin market cap surpasses ETH market cap. SEC delays options on Fidelity ETH ETF. Fed classifies BTC as a ‘hard reserve asset’. UAE sovereign fund invests $2bn in Binance. Ripple gets first payments license in Dubai. Ripple-SEC settlement may include sales ban. Russia set to open crypto trading for locals. Rumble buys $17m BTC. Franklin files for SOL ETF with CBOE. Cantor Fitzgerald launches BTC backed lending. Lazarus sends 400 ETH to Tornado cash. MEXC acquires $16m ENA, $20m USDe. India arrests Garantex co-founder.
articles.title: BTC dominance Rising, Cool CPI boosts Markets, Coinbase delists memes

articles.description: BTC recovers to $84k after softer CPI. ETH/BTC at levels last seen in Dec 2020. ETH whale liquidated, FUD over HYPE contagion. Whales accumulate 65k BTC amid crypto crashes. 7 more reps support Lummis plan to buy 1m BTC. CBOE seeks to add staking to Fidelity ETH ETF. SEC delays decision on XRP, SOL, LTC, DOGE ETF. BTC heading towards $73k: 10X Research. BTC pain tied to equities: StanChart. House passes resolution to kill IRS DeFI broker rule. House committee starts stablecoin discussions. No plans for more crypto summits: White House. Saylor urges US to acquire 25% of BTC supply. VC funding dipping below 2017-18 levels. Metaplanet buys $13.5m BTC. HK company Lead Benefit buys $27m BTC. Sony and LINE join forces in blockchain deal. OKX blames Bybit for hack investigation.
articles.title: Crypto Bounce on soft CPI, ETH whale Liquidated, S&P500 in Correction
